svg.title: The three parts of a closed loop
svg.desc: A coding agent in a harness.run step produces a result. A signal from outside the agent measures it: a command in repeat_policy, a reviewer agent with output_schema, or a person in a human.task step. A failure takes the route back to the agent with what the check found. A pass lets the next step run. When the limit is reached, the workflow fails or hands the work over.
